text: User requirements remain undefined and the components to be included in the design are unclear, signaling a need for clearer communication about requirements and design details to avoid miscommunication.
The Marketing Expert will perform market research and user interviews to develop user requirements.
The UI Designer will specify the technical functions, and the Industrial Designer will work on the conceptual design.
The Project Manager will summarize the discussed items and organize them in the project folder.

Decisions establish pricing at 25 Euros, production cost at 12.5 Euros, target sales of 50 million Euros, a three-phase project structure, starting with TV and video only, and a simple interface with the least number of functions.
